card.name: "Consistent with" in lowest-dose advice
card.fires_on: The word "with" right after "consistent" in the stock phrase "lowest effective dose for the shortest duration consistent with individual patient treatment goals". It also fires weakly on a few other fixed phrases, such as "according to" and citation numbers.

modes.label: Consistent with goals
modes.description: The word "with" after "consistent" in the NSAID and opioid dosing sentence.
modes.example: Use the lowest effective dose for the shortest duration consistent<< with>> individual patient treatment goals (see WARNINGS

modes.label: According to protocols
modes.description: The word "to" after "according" in a management instruction.
modes.example: requires management according<< to>> protocols developed by neonatology experts.

modes.label: Reference numbers
modes.description: Digits inside journal issue numbers or ISSN codes in citations.

card.plain: It marks the linking word in the fixed sentence about using the lowest dose for the shortest time, consistent with patient goals.
